info.description:
Lithuanian construction takeoff API. Endpoints accept BOTH the unprefixed `/api/...` path (legacy, supported indefinitely for backward compatibility) AND the versioned `/api/v1/...` path (canonical, used by the viewer rebuild). Both route to the same handler — the v1 prefix is a path-rewrite, not a deployment split.

## URL prefix

Every path documented below also responds under `/api/v1/<rest>`. The viewer rebuild SHOULD prefer `/api/v1/...` for forward-compatibility; legacy `/api/...` paths remain supported indefinitely for older clients.

- {"project_id": "...", "question": "..."}                    (preferred — fetches fresh from DB)
- {"project_id": "...", "messages": [{role, content}, ...]}   (with conversation history)
- {"project_context": {...}, "question": "..."}               (legacy fallback — uses passed data)
